collection.title: Ford Focus Saloon 2004 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Saloon 2004 - 2006 version requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 17" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
